acceptance.description: cli > env > config.toml > default, None ignored, data_root toml discovery, loopback host, port range, malformed TOML line, unknown key
packaged models.toml keys, no model id literal under src/, editing models.toml alone changes artifact sidecar model_id, missing license listing
DB row and sidecar agree on prompt/seed/model/version etc. for image/audio/video jobs and direct writes
cache hit with no job, new seed misses, missing/corrupt file or sidecar misses, atomic write layout/sha256/take numbering, fingerprint sensitivity
hard-kill of `reelforge up` mid heavy job, recover_orphans requeues, clears pid/lease, keeps finished artifacts; dead-pid row recovery
cancel running/queued, retry-once-then-fail with exactly 2 runs, non-transient no retry, exit code, unknown type, manual retry reset
preflight reason text, unload first, wait/poll, job not started on low memory, two heavy jobs never overlap, lease hold/release
classify_exit for -9/137 only, runner classification, job fails with OOM reason after one retry
CHECKS order, report props, doctor table/exit codes, up refuse/allow-degraded/step order, /health parity, disk/memory/ports/licenses rules
media 403 for .. and symlink escapes, 404s, loopback-only validation and listening socket, no shell=True
conftest socket guard blocks non-loopback and allows loopback
upgrade creates tables with WAL, pragmas, table names, ULIDs, relative paths, data root layout
project CRUD/validation/order, stages, artifacts endpoint, jobs list/cancel/retry, websocket events, health.changed, openapi export
logging JSON, adapter.command argv verbatim, timeout kill, log file, job timeout reason

runs web vitest suite (web/tests/acceptance: events, projects, stages, settings) and Playwright flows (web/e2e/live-progress.spec.ts: list+stepper render, live progress over /ws/events without polling jobs)

untestable.reason: Ruff, pyright, eslint, tsc and the web build are the standards' lint/typecheck/build commands, run by the verifier, not by pytest.
